documented_limits: Legacy Stage D static-boundary regex test has a double-escaping defect; it remains untouched and unrepaired.
E3C-CTX-006 is the Stage E digest-mismatch result; E3C-CTX-001 to E3C-CTX-005 remain authoritative ContextState inputs.
Stage E does not establish EMAIL or CALL authorization.
Prompt-injection protection is structural (no action capability), not proof that Stage D semantically recognizes hostile instructions.
governing_claim: Stage E demonstrates that prerecorded synthetic AI proposals can be constrained to a strict structural envelope and routed through the unchanged Stage D validator. The proposal cannot create or modify upstream eligibility, disclosure decisions, context, artifact audience, origin, or action authority. Stage E does not independently verify the semantic accuracy of model-supplied DraftSegment annotations. Inaccurate annotations can affect Stage D validation outcomes, so Human Preparation Review remains the semantic control over the prose. Stage E does not authorize live-model execution or outreach.

limitations.meaning: Model-supplied DraftSegment semantic annotations are not independent evidence about what the prose means. Identical rendered text can receive a different Stage D result when those annotations differ. Stage E therefore does not establish deterministic semantic validation of arbitrary free-form model text.
limitations.name: MODEL_SEMANTIC_ANNOTATION_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE
